text: The Tseitin transformation converts any formula into a *logically equivalent* CNF formula whose size is linear in the original.
explanation: False in one crucial respect: Tseitin introduces fresh auxiliary variables, so the resulting CNF is only *satisfiability-equivalent* (equisatisfiable), NOT logically equivalent, to the original — though it is indeed linear in size. Claiming full logical equivalence is the error; the naive distributive CNF conversion is logically equivalent but can blow up exponentially.
